shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and event-driven work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics, with documented deviations: floor removal only drops things when the exposed terrain is open air; bomb-punched rooftop holes deferred.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; sync handlers shut down on error, renderer fails open to opaque-below.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T1.7)
- Core (T0): LevelComp registry on pocket maps aligned 1:1, ground comp as column controller, parent.Tile set for real day/night + geology; stairs pairs that generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains (GenStep_ABSkyTerrain): mass contracted one cell (walkable ledge ring); two UNROOFED, UNFOGGED face rows render their real rock texture; deep core = thick rock roof + fog. Thin-roof overhang = open air; constructed roofs below = rooftop terrain.
- Fog lifecycle: core fogged at gen; guaranteed reveal on mineable removal via ThingDespawned handlers (sky + basement); landings unfog and mine out their 3x3.
- See-below renderer (Harmony), the hard-won architecture:
  - Surface section submeshes drawn at y=-2.5 under the sky map (submeshes above y=2 excluded: vanilla fog and lighting overlay meshes MUST NOT be drawn into the below-view; their shaders ignore depth and paint over upper-level content, which masqueraded as an unremovable fog bug for several rounds).
  - Air-cells-only mask mesh at y=-0.10 (rebuilt every 15 frames or on view change, 32-bit indices, step-2 sampling at far zoom): per cell opaque black where the surface is unexplored (fog of war knowledge preserved), otherwise alpha = user base dim + darkness from real per-cell light (artificial glow from the surface's glow grid, skylight from the CURRENT map's sky manager because inactive maps do not update theirs). Lamp pools below glow through the air at night. Structurally cannot cover upper-level rock: geometry exists only over open air.
  - Live dynamic things below via DrawPos offset flag; camera far clip 65.5 -> 70.
- Live sync (LevelSync via MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above live; sky floors write constructed roofs below; things over open air fall with Z-Levels-style consequences.

## Quadruple pass log
T1.1 far clip 92%; T1.2 contraction 90%; T1.3 fog band 90%; T1.4 mining reveal 90%; T1.6 unroofed face rows 92%; T1.7 air-only mask 88%. Postmortem note: the recurring "upper edge fogged" was three stacked causes fixed in sequence: roofed face rows (T1.6), then the relocated vanilla fog/lighting overlays painting over the mountain regardless of depth (T1.7); the diagnostic ruled out glow values. Polish backlog: far-zoom silhouettes below; water-depth submeshes below; natural-roof removal under sky mountains; bomb holes in rooftops; sky-level projectiles crossing air get mask-dimmed.

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE, T1 through T1.7 CODE DONE (T1.7 awaiting in-game verification).
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3 (next after T1 sign-off, user-requested): cross-map stockpiles/hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature/weather sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish.

## Status
T1.7 compiled green, pushed. Pending in-game verification: upper rock faces fully visible with real textures, dev fog tools behave, unexplored surface still hidden from above, night dimming through air only.
